items.title: Optional banner blur
items.text: Turn on “Blur my banner behind my profile” in your profile editor. Your banner is stretched, blurred and faded into your card theme.

items.title: New checkboxes
items.text: Every checkbox in Aduna now has the same rounded look, in your theme’s colors.

items.title: Smoother update notes
items.text: Update notes are now prepared for every release, so What’s new stays complete and up to date.

items.title: New minigame: Contexto
items.text: Open the + menu, pick Minigames, then Contexto. Guess the secret word of the day by meaning: every word you try gets a number, and the closer its meaning, the lower the number. 1 is the word itself.

items.title: Play on your own or with a server
items.text: Aduna has its own daily word, and every server gets one of its own with standings for its members. Use a hint if you are stuck, give up to see the word, and share your result into any chat.

items.title: Faster first Wordle guess
items.text: Wordle’s word list is now ready before you play, so your first guess no longer takes a moment to check.

items.title: Contexto keeps your cursor
items.text: After you press Enter on a guess in Contexto, you can keep typing without clicking the box again.

title: Tag channels, to-do lists and goals

items.title: Tag a channel with #
items.text: Type # in a server chat and pick a channel. It shows as a chip in the message, and clicking it takes you straight to that channel. It keeps working if the channel is renamed.

items.title: To-do channels
items.text: A new channel type for a shared task list. Owners choose which roles can add tasks, tasks can be given to a role, and the people holding that role can tick them off.

items.title: Goals channels
items.text: A new channel type where the owner sets goals with progress bars or checkboxes, and everyone in the server can follow how they are going.

items.title: Server templates
items.text: Start a new server from a ready-made template with channels and roles already set up, for example a business or a community.

title: Webhooks, smarter bots and a name checker

items.title: Server webhooks
items.text: Server managers can create a secret web address that other services post to. A webhook can drop a message in a text channel or hand its data to one of the server's bots. There is a generic JSON kind and a GitHub kind for push events.

items.title: Bots hear webhooks
items.text: Bots can now react to data that arrives through a webhook of their server, so a bot can post build results or alerts in its own words.

items.title: Bots see reactions
items.text: Bots can now react when someone adds a reaction to a message, in addition to messages, joins, leaves and timers.

items.title: Name checker
items.text: Usernames, display names, bios and server names are checked. If one is not appropriate you get a warning in the app and 3 days from the moment you see it to change it.

items.title: Themes tab in Explorer
items.text: Explorer has a new Themes tab for browsing themes.

items.title: Pictures and banners for bots
items.text: Bot developers can now give a bot a picture and a wide banner in Settings > Developer. The banner shows on the bot’s page and on its profile.

items.title: Long description for bots
items.text: A bot can have a longer description of up to 1,500 characters, with line breaks, to explain what it does and how to use it.

items.title: Bot pages in Explorer
items.text: On the Bots tab, bots now show their banner and picture. Press Read more, or a bot’s name, to open its page and add it to a server.

items.title: Longer messages with Aduna Plus
items.text: Aduna Plus members can write messages up to 4,000 characters instead of 2,000. A counter appears in the message box as you get close to the limit.

title: Zoom while you share your screen

items.title: Zoom in on your cursor
items.text: In the Aduna desktop app, while you share your whole screen, press Ctrl + Alt + Shift + Z to zoom the shared picture in on your cursor. Press it again to zoom back out. Scroll while zoomed in to zoom even closer. You still see your normal screen; only the people watching see the zoom.

items.title: Pick your own shortcut
items.text: Don’t like the shortcut? Change it in Settings > Voice & Video. It has to include Ctrl, Alt or Win so normal typing is never affected.
